product.summary: Current self-custodial My Wallet mobile application, preserving the former MyTonWallet product lineage.
product.notes: Selected mobile runtime only. Browser extension, desktop and Telegram mini-app surfaces are deferred. Rebrand does not reset launch chronology.

events.title: My Wallet v26.8.3 released
events.description: The official My Wallet/MyTonWallet repository released v26.8.3. The release fixed an activity-feed loading failure affecting freshly created Solana wallets and included desktop and Android application artifacts under the continuing My Wallet/MyTonWallet lineage.

events.title: MyTonWallet officially rebranded to My Wallet
events.description: My Wallet announced on 2026-06-17 that MyTonWallet was officially becoming My Wallet, retaining the same product and team while adopting a broader multichain identity after expanding beyond TON.

evidence.title: Install My Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party distribution surface for the renamed My Wallet product family; mobile is selected for this breadth pass while other runtimes are deferred.

evidence.title: My Wallet 26.8.3
evidence.notes: Official repository release. Release assets include both MyWallet and MyTonWallet-branded artifacts, consistent with WLR's existing continuous entity lineage across the rebrand.

evidence.title: MyTonWallet is becoming My Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party rebrand announcement explicitly states MyTonWallet -> My Wallet.
